title: The Four Wars and the Four Salvations
description: T17 unfolds the four contests by which the soul is regenerated: the Divine Human breaking the proprium's claim that it is its own source; the operative power gathering disordered self-loves in three accommodations and binding them; the call exposing the proprium's counterfeit richness; the call's work received by Jesus the Radiance who orders the lights at every register. T18 unfolds the parallel four salvations: the Divine Human preserving what is the Lord's within the natural; the operative power building structure within which the swallowed light can be raised; the call drawing out what had been clutched by the very showing; divine truth shining choosing out and setting aright. Each war is met by an answering deliverance — what could not be received at one stage is delivered at the next.
